QuestInfo.name: [MONAD: The First Omen] Shabby Armor
QuestInfo.0: Sanaan and Elva are repairing a large piece of old armor.
QuestInfo.1: While Sanaan and Elva repair a large piece of old armor, Sanaan exclaims over the horns on either side of the helmet and hopes the worn armor will give the troublemaker, Einar, some courage.
QuestInfo.2: While Sanaan and Elva repaired a large piece of old armor, Sanaan exclaimed over the horns on either side of the helmet and expressed the hope that the worn armor would give the troublemaker, Einar, some courage.
